finding.baseline: The real applyQueue returned a refusal for an uncommitted post-draw source, but finishCore retained the model's successful response text (for example, 'Done. Updated the roof.') and logged an AI completion. Failure notes existed, but did not remove the false primary claim.
finding.repair: In isolated finishCore, when applyQueue returns zero applied lines and one or more failures, replace the primary reply with 'I could not apply that change yet.' plus the bounded first failure reason; leave undoable false and delete the undo snapshot. Partial success keeps the existing reply and per-operation failure notes.
